deliberateDepartures: Used the mandatory light semantic palette and white surface instead of the example’s warm paper and brown pencil palette.
Used Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif instead of the example’s casual Latin typefaces.
Kept text upright and reduced hatching to sparse corner marks to protect Japanese readability at target CSS dimensions.
Used open arrowheads and lightly irregular paths, with dashed outlines or connectors for pending states.
Authored SVG viewBoxes at each session target size; placement frames remain host context rather than being included in the artwork.
fontUncertainty: All five SVGs declare Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif. Fonts are not bundled. Actual rendering font, fallback selection and missing-glyph behavior were not verified; no environment font inventory or browser was consulted.
limitations: No browser rendering or independent evaluator feedback was used. XML and exact label preservation checks are author checks and do not establish visual acceptance or approval.
